versions.assumed: The two kW figures, and only those. The periods are 2.0TD's own and are verified: P1 (punta) Monday to Friday on working days 08:00–24:00, P2 (valle) the rest of those days plus all of Saturdays, Sundays, 6 January and the national holidays — which is why the P1 filter carries `holidays: exclude` and P2 carries no filter at all. The pair 4.6 kW in punta and 5.75 kW in valle is a *default the flow offers*, not anyone's contract: 4.6 kW (230 V × 20 A) is D2 §6's ES default and 5.75 kW (230 V × 25 A) is the next normalised step, in that order because the documented 2.0TD saving strategy is a higher power in valle — when the washing machine, dishwasher and EV run — and a lower one in punta. Every household enters its own two potencias, which are printed on its bill. The ICP tolerance of 10 % for 30 s is D2 §4's.
